topic: Someone finds out their best friend is moving across the country
text: I can't quite grasp how the room has turned into a vast, untouched beach, but the news is heavier than the shifting sands beneath my feet. Your moving, a fact as solid as the horizon, stretches endlessly before us. I'll wrap my thoughts in shells and scatter them along the shore, but the tide, relentless, will take them away. I'm collecting words, trying to build a castle that stands, a fortress of memories where time moves differently, or not at all. Maybe if I speak in the language of the sea, you'll understand the depth, the width, the impossible spaces inside me that you fill, that you’re leaving. The sky above us rearranges itself, and I wonder if the stars know how to rebuild what's about to be torn apart.
